description: This file contains the implementation of the LeaveApplicationService class, responsible for managing leave applications, including applying for leave, validation, and event dispatching within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin.

classes.name: LeaveApplicationService
classes.description: Service class for handling leave applications, including creating new leave requests, validating leave periods, and managing leave workflows within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Creates a new leave application after performing validation checks on date limits, overlapping leaves, and shift length constraints. Returns a LeaveRequest object if successful.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Handles the process of saving a leave request, including creating leave objects, handling entitlements, commenting, and dispatching leave application events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the leave request status based on whether the date falls on a weekend, holiday, or regular working day, and returns the appropriate status code.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether employees are allowed to exceed their leave balance; here, returns false, disallowing such action.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForApplyAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item for the 'APPLY' action, caching the result for efficiency.
